The special token [NA] is used to represent 'Not Applicable Citations' for conscious incompetence.

facts.fact: Self-Refine (Madan et al., 2023) is a method that uses one LLM guided by varied prompts for the roles of generation, critic, and refinement.
Clinical Self-Verification (Gero et al., 2023) applies the Self-Refine method to extract clinical data, refining by spotting missing elements and verifying data accuracy.
Reflexion (Shinn et al., 2023) extends the Self-Refine method by adding a 'long-term memory' to recall past errors and integrating diverse feedback forms.

In Table 2, the methods that use the Self-Refine strategy are: Self-Refine (Madan et al., 2023), Clinical SV (Gero et al., 2023), Reflexion (Shinn et al., 2023), IterRefinement (Chen et al., 2023d), Auto-Post-Editing (Rumak et al., 2023), RCI (Kim et al., 2023), SelfFee (Ye et al., 2023), SelfCheckGPT (Manakul et al., 2023), and LLM Self Defense (Helbling et al., 2023).
